experiments.name: Passive Observation
experiments.description: Observe the artifact under standard conditions without interference.

experiments.name: Heating
experiments.description: Apply heat to the artifact and observe thermal response.

experiments.name: Cooling
experiments.description: Cool the artifact and observe thermal equilibrium behavior.

experiments.name: Electrical Exposure
experiments.description: Apply electrical current and observe instrumentation effects.

experiments.name: X-Ray Imaging
experiments.description: Perform X-ray imaging to examine internal structure.

experiments.name: Electromagnetic Exposure — Low Frequency
experiments.description: Expose artifact to low-frequency EM field.

experiments.name: Electromagnetic Exposure — Mid Frequency
experiments.description: Expose artifact to mid-frequency EM field.

experiments.name: Electromagnetic Exposure — Resonance Range
experiments.description: Expose artifact to resonance range EM field (≈18.3 GHz).

experiments.name: Acoustic Resonance
experiments.description: Apply acoustic vibrations and listen for internal resonance or structural response.

experiments.name: Laser Spectroscopy
experiments.description: Analyze surface reflectivity and emission spectrum using a focused laser.

experiments.name: Vibration Analysis
experiments.description: Measure the artifact's vibrational modes and damping behavior.

experiments.name: Radioactive Exposure
experiments.description: Expose the artifact to low-level radiation and measure absorption or emission.

experiments.name: Harmonic Lattice Mapping
experiments.description: Drive the Sphere at its lattice resonance and map the standing harmonics. The signature run for the Sphere.

experiments.name: Focal Point Survey
experiments.description: Track what the Lens focuses when nobody is looking through it. Careful, patient work.

experiments.name: Resonant Overdrive
experiments.description: Push the Cylinder past its rated resonance. Enormous insight. Occasional equipment fires.

experiments.name: Choral Transcription
experiments.description: Record the Choir Glass at full voice and transcribe what it is trying to say. Bring ear protection and an open mind.

experiments.name: Germination Watch
experiments.description: Sit with the Winter Seed and observe, hour by hour, what it refuses to become. Slow, safe, cumulative.

experiments.name: Event Horizon Probe
experiments.description: Lower instruments toward the Torus aperture until telemetry disagrees with itself. Do not lower hands.

experiments.name: Brine Evaporation Trial
experiments.description: Evaporate Choir salt under controlled heat and weigh what the song leaves behind.

experiments.name: Audit the Ledger
experiments.description: Reconcile the Stone's tallies against the lab's own books. Discrepancies are the data.

experiments.name: Failure Offering
experiments.description: Feed the Lantern a curated failed run and measure the flare. Waste nothing, especially failure.

experiments.name: Attention Farming
experiments.description: Observe the Orchard in measured doses and harvest the lumen fruit. Watch the watcher back.

experiments.name: Hadal Toll
experiments.description: Strike the Bell at full amplitude under full shielding. Eleven kilometers down, on purpose, briefly.

experiments.name: Cold Light Harvest
experiments.description: Collect the Paper Sun's flameless emission and meter it against the room's falling temperature.

experiments.name: Rehearsal Observation
experiments.description: Stage precise gestures and return tomorrow to watch the void perform them. Scheduling is everything.

experiments.name: Full Load Draw
experiments.description: Draw full shaft work from the Pale Engine for one hour and account for every missing joule.

experiments.name: Eighth Door Survey
experiments.description: Map the museum's rooms from the threshold without crossing. Measure twice, enter never.

experiments.name: Interrogation by Candlelight
experiments.description: Hold reviews around the Saint and log where the flame leans. The candle conducts the meeting.

experiments.name: Lock Census
experiments.description: Present the Key to every lock in the building, catalogued, and record what each one surrenders.

experiments.name: Upward Drift Measurement
experiments.description: Meter the rising dust around the flake to four decimals and ask gravity, politely, to explain.
